notes.title: Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
Added several keyboard inputs
- Backspace to undo
- Tilde to toggle transparency
- R to reset
Added fullscreen/window toggle in config

notes.title: Version 1.1 is Live
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

It's been a busy year for myself, but I've finally managed to push out an update. The changes are as follows:

- Brand new world with 12 new levels
- Visual update for the dice
- Some graphical fixes for toggling hide dice and simple environments
- Various other fixes
